texts.title: Speak with Confidence: A One-Day Presentation Seminar
lines: Date: Saturday, June 14, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Place: Hall B, Lin Business Center

Learn how to plan a clear, logical talk, design simple slides, and handle difficult questions from the audience. In the afternoon, each participant will give a talk of five minutes and get comments from our instructor, Ms. Grace Huang. Ms. Huang has trained sales teams at more than fifty companies. Seats are limited to thirty people.
Fee: $180 per person, lunch included. Companies that register five or more employees receive 20 percent off.
Register by June 6 on our website.

texts.title: Subject: Seminar on June 14
lines: From: Alan Wu, Sales Manager
To: Mia Chen, Human Resources
Hi Mia,
I found a seminar that could help our sales team before the trade show in July. Please see the flyer below. I would like to send six people from our team, including me.
Could you register us this week? Our training budget for this quarter is $1,000, so the group discount is important.
Also, two of us, Mr. Kim and Ms. Ota, have a client visit that morning until 11 a.m. Could you ask the seminar office whether they can join after that?
Thanks, Alan

questions.en: Why did Mr. Wu write to Ms. Chen?
questions.zh: Wu 先生為什麼寫信給 Chen 小姐？
options: To ask her to sign his team up for a seminar
To invite her to speak at a trade show
To report on a visit to a client
To ask her to plan the team's budget

questions.en: How much will the seminar cost Mr. Wu's team in total?
questions.zh: Wu 先生的團隊參加研討會總共要花多少錢？

questions.en: What is suggested about Mr. Kim and Ms. Ota?
questions.zh: 關於 Kim 先生和 Ota 小姐，文中暗示了什麼？
options: They will speak at the trade show in July.
They will not give a talk in the afternoon.
They work in the Human Resources department.
They might miss the first part of the seminar.

questions.en: In the flyer, the word "handle" is closest in meaning to
questions.zh: 傳單中的 "handle" 意思最接近
options: pick up
deal with
carry
repeat

texts.title: Wellness Week, May 12-16
lines: All events are free for employees. Please sign up by May 8 with Lisa Park in Human Resources (extension 214).
Monday: Yoga for beginners, 12:15-12:45, Room 5A
Tuesday: Health checkup with a clinic nurse, 9:00-4:00, Room 2C (15 minutes each, by appointment)
Wednesday: Talk on healthy eating at work, 12:15-1:00, Cafeteria
Thursday: Neck and shoulder massage, 2:00-5:00, Room 2C (20 minutes each, by appointment)
Friday: Walking group, 5:30-6:30, meet at the front entrance

texts.title: Subject: Wellness Week
lines: From: Tom Hsu
To: Lisa Park
Hi Lisa,
I'd like to sign up for the health checkup and the massage. I meet a client every Tuesday morning, so could I have a time after lunch for the checkup? For the massage, any time is fine.
I'd also like to hear the talk, but I'll be on a business trip in Tainan that day. Will it be recorded?
Thanks, Tom

texts.title: Subject: Re: Wellness Week
lines: From: Lisa Park
To: Tom Hsu
Hi Tom,
I've booked your checkup for 2:30 p.m. and your massage for 3:40 p.m. Please arrive five minutes early for both.
The talk will not be recorded, but the speaker has agreed to share her slides. I'll email them to everyone on May 15.
Also, because of a problem with the schedule, the walking group has moved from Friday to Thursday at the same time.
Best, Lisa

questions.en: Why does Mr. Hsu ask for an afternoon checkup?
questions.zh: Hsu 先生為什麼要求下午做健康檢查？
options: He will be in Tainan that morning.
The nurse works only after lunch.
He is busy on Tuesday mornings.
His massage is in the morning.

questions.en: On what day will Mr. Hsu be in Tainan?
questions.zh: Hsu 先生哪一天會在台南？
options: Wednesday
Monday
Tuesday
Thursday

questions.en: Where should Mr. Hsu go at 3:35 p.m. on Thursday?
questions.zh: Hsu 先生星期四下午三點三十五分應該去哪裡？
options: Room 5A
The cafeteria
The front entrance
Room 2C

questions.en: What will Ms. Park send on May 15?
questions.zh: Park 小姐五月十五日會寄出什麼？
options: A recording of the talk
The slides from the talk on healthy eating
A new schedule for Wellness Week
Mr. Hsu's appointment times

questions.en: What is suggested about the walking group?
questions.zh: 關於健走團，文中暗示了什麼？
options: It will now meet on the same day as Mr. Hsu's massage.
It has been canceled because of the weather.
It will start earlier than planned.
It will meet in Room 2C.

texts.title: Green Table Catering
lines: Planning a meeting, a training day, or a company party? Green Table Catering serves fresh, healthy food for groups of 10 to 200.
Lunch boxes: $12 per person (sandwich, salad, fruit)
Hot buffet: $20 per person (two main dishes, rice, soup, dessert)
Coffee and tea break: $5 per person
Free delivery within the city for orders over $300. Please order at least three working days before your event. Vegetarian choices are available for every menu at no extra cost.

texts.title: Subject: Lunch for our annual meeting
lines: To: Green Table Catering
From: Joyce Lin, Office Manager
Hello,

Our company is holding its annual meeting on Friday, November 21, at the Grand Plaza Hotel downtown. Eighty employees will attend. We would like the hot buffet for lunch and one coffee and tea break in the afternoon.
About fifteen of our employees do not eat meat. Could you tell me how this would change the price?
Also, the hotel has asked us to finish lunch by 1:30 p.m., because another group is using the room after us. Please have the food ready by 12:00.
Best regards, Joyce Lin

questions.en: Why did Ms. Lin write the email?
questions.zh: Lin 小姐為什麼寫這封電子郵件？
options: To book a room at a hotel
To order food for a company event
To change the date of a meeting
To ask about working at Green Table

questions.en: How much will Ms. Lin's company pay for the food and drinks?
questions.zh: Lin 小姐的公司餐點和飲料總共要付多少錢？

questions.en: What will most likely happen with the employees who do not eat meat?
questions.zh: 不吃肉的員工最可能會怎麼樣？
options: They will get vegetarian food at no extra charge.
The company will pay an extra fee for them.
They will get lunch boxes instead.
They will eat lunch after 1:30 p.m.

questions.en: What does Ms. Lin say about the hotel room?
questions.zh: Lin 小姐提到飯店場地的什麼事？
options: It can hold up to 200 people.
It is outside the city.
Another group will use it after lunch.
It will be ready at 12:00.

texts.title: Sales Assistant (Part Time), Harbor Lamps, Tamsui Store
lines: Hours: Saturday and Sunday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Duties: help customers choose lamps, work the cash register, and keep the shelves tidy.
Requirements: at least one year of experience in a store and basic English. You must be able to work every weekend.
Email your résumé to Ms. Ivy Chou, Store Manager, by Friday, March 7. Interviews will be held the following week.

texts.title: Subject: Sales assistant job
lines: Dear Ms. Chou,

I am writing to apply for the weekend sales assistant job at your Tamsui store. For the past two years, I have worked as a cashier at a supermarket near Tamsui Station, where I also help customers find products. I am studying English at night, and I can answer simple questions from foreign visitors.
I can work every weekend. I take classes in the mornings, so I am free for an interview on weekdays after 3 p.m.
My résumé is attached.
Sincerely, Ben Lai

texts.title: Interview Schedule: Tamsui Store
lines: Monday, March 10, 10:00 a.m.: Ms. Amy Lu
Monday, March 10, 3:30 p.m.: Mr. Ben Lai
Tuesday, March 11, 11:00 a.m.: Mr. Kevin Ho
Wednesday, March 12, 4:00 p.m.: Ms. Lily Chen
Ms. Ivy Chou will meet every applicant. Please bring a photo ID.

questions.en: What does the ad say is required for the job?
questions.zh: 徵人廣告說這份工作需要什麼條件？
options: Living near Tamsui Station
Speaking fluent English
Having worked in a supermarket
Being free to work on weekends

questions.en: Which part of Mr. Lai's experience meets a requirement in the ad?
questions.zh: Lai 先生的哪一項經歷符合廣告裡的條件？
options: He works near Tamsui Station.
He has worked in a store for two years.
He takes classes in the mornings.
He is free on weekday afternoons.

questions.en: What is true about Mr. Lai's interview?
questions.zh: 關於 Lai 先生的面試，下列何者正確？
options: It is the first interview of the week.
It will be held on a weekend.
It is at a time when he said he was free.
It will take place before March 7.

questions.en: In the ad, the word "tidy" is closest in meaning to
questions.zh: 廣告中的 "tidy" 意思最接近
options: in good order
full
small
new

questions.en: What will Mr. Lai probably need to bring on March 10?
questions.zh: Lai 先生三月十日可能需要帶什麼？
options: A copy of his class schedule
A card that shows his picture
A letter from the supermarket
A second copy of his résumé
